name: ShopSphere - AWS e-commerce platform
description: Consumer e-commerce storefront on AWS (ALB, EC2 Auto Scaling, RDS PostgreSQL, S3, SQS, NAT gateway) with deliberately injected security, resilience, cost and operability weaknesses.

revision.title: Hardening revision 1
revision.change_notes: Database moved to a private multi-AZ deployment with encryption and backups; security groups restricted; IAM policy scoped; DLQ and alarms added; Auto Scaling spread across two AZs. A replicated disaster-recovery bucket was added for invoices.
